estate_agency.law: Codul civil (Legea 287/2009, republicată) arts 2096-2102 (contractul de intermediere). No sector-specific estate-agency statute.
estate_agency.regulated: Not licensed: no statutory licence or registration for estate agents beyond company registration and AML notification to ONPCSB. A draft regulating access to the profession (authorisation plus a RENII register at ANCPI, training, professional insurance) is reported in Parliament; not confirmed as adopted.
estate_agency.rule: The Civil Code does not prohibit one intermediary dealing with both sides. Art 2096(2): the intermediary is not the agent (prepus) of the intermediated parties and is independent of them. Art 2100: it must give the third party all information on the advantages of the deal, provided it does not culpably harm the client's interests. Art 2102: it may represent the parties in concluding the contract only if expressly authorised. Art 2097(1): commission is due from the client only if the contract is concluded as a result of the intermediation.
estate_agency.quote: Codul civil art 2096(2): 'Intermediarul nu este prepusul părţilor intermediate şi este independent faţă de acestea în executarea obligaţiilor sale.' (EN: The intermediary is not the agent of the intermediated parties and is independent of them in performing its obligations.) Art 2102: '... numai dacă a fost împuternicit expres în acest sens.' (EN: ... only if expressly empowered to do so.)
estate_agency.commission_both_sides: Not prohibited. Each client who signs an intermediation contract owes commission (art 2097). Art 2099: several intermediaries split a global fee equally unless agreed otherwise. Art 2101: a client who fails to notify conclusion within 15 days owes double remuneration unless the contract provides otherwise.

aml.law: Legea nr. 129/2019, art 5(1)(h) scope; art 11(10) inserted by Legea 86/2025 (MO 483/23.05.2025); art 21 retention. Supervisor: ONPCSB (Oficiul Național de Prevenire și Combatere a Spălării Banilor).
aml.sale_scope: Every transaction of agenții și dezvoltatorii imobiliari (art 5(1)(h)).
aml.letting_threshold: Lettings only where monthly rent is the lei equivalent of EUR 10,000 or more (art 5(1)(h)).
aml.both_parties: yes. Art 11(10), added by Legea 86/2025: 'În cazul tranzacţiilor imobiliare, agentul imobiliar aplică măsurile de cunoaştere a clientelei atât pentru promitentul vânzător, cât şi pentru promitentul cumpărător al imobilului.' (EN: In real-estate transactions the agent applies KYC measures to both the promissory seller and the promissory buyer.)
aml.retention_trigger: Art 21(1)-(2): 5 years from the end of the business relationship with the client or from the date of the occasional transaction.
aml.extension: Art 21(3): extended for the period indicated by the competent authorities, by no more than 5 years. Art 21(4): on expiry, personal data must be deleted unless other law requires retention.
aml.id_copy: Allowed and expected: art 21(1) lists 'copii ale documentelor de identificare' (EN: copies of identification documents) among the CDD records to keep.

accounting.trigger: Legea contabilității 82/1991 art 25(1) as amended: mandatory accounting registers and source documents are kept for 5 years from the close of the financial year in which they were drawn up. Art 23(1): electronically processed accounting data, 5 years from 1 January of the year after that financial year.
accounting.law: Legea contabilității nr. 82/1991, art 25(1) and art 23(1), as amended by the 2023 law adopted as Senate file L621/2022

limitation.trigger: Art 2523: from when the right-holder knew or should have known the right arose. Art 2524(1): for contractual obligations, from when the obligation becomes due.
limitation.law: Codul civil art 2517 ('Termenul prescripţiei este de 3 ani, dacă legea nu prevede un alt termen'); art 2519(2): 2 years for 'plata remuneraţiei cuvenite intermediarilor pentru serviciile prestate în baza contractului de intermediere' (EN: payment of remuneration owed to intermediaries for services under an intermediation contract); arts 2523-2524

id_copies.rule: Legea 190/2018 art 4: processing a national identification number (CNP, ID card series and number, passport number), including collecting documents that contain it, needs a GDPR art 6(1) basis. Under legitimate interest (6(1)(f)) the controller must have: technical and organisational measures for minimisation and security, a designated DPO, retention periods set by nature and purpose, and regular staff training. AML copies rest on a legal obligation (Legea 129/2019 art 21).
